meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 在DNAnexus上构建和运行可复现的基因组学工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在DNAnexus平台上自动化基因组学数据处理和运行分析流程
copy.tagline_en: Build and run reproducible genomics workflows on DNAnexus
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate genomics data processing and run analysis pipelines on the DNAnexus platform

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以帮你操作DNAnexus云平台：上传/下载文件、创建和运行app/applet、用dxpy写脚本、管理工作流和数据。
howto.when: 当你提到DNAnexus、基因组学数据分析（如FASTQ、BAM、VCF）、或需要上传/下载文件、运行工作流时触发。

say.text: 创建一个简单的app模板，用dx-app-wizard。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can operate the DNAnexus cloud platform: upload/download files, create and run apps/applets, write dxpy scripts, manage workflows and data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention DNAnexus, genomic data analysis (e.g., FASTQ, BAM, VCF), or need to upload/download files, run workflows.

say_en.text: Help me upload local file sample.fastq to project project-xxxx using dxpy.
say_en.note: Claude will call dxpy to upload and return file ID.

say_en.text: Create a simple app template using dx-app-wizard.
say_en.note: Claude will guide generating app skeleton code.

say_en.text: Run applet-xxxx to align BAM files.
say_en.note: Claude will call run method to start the job.
